description: Turns MIDI controller messages into note messages, one note per controller number, for playing from the buttons on a controller

params.text: Scales the velocity of the notes sent; the controller's own value is multiplied by this, so at full clockwise a value of 127 gives velocity 127 and at halfway it gives 63
Moves the notes up one octave for each press, as far as six octaves above normal
Puts the notes back to no octave shift
Moves the notes down one octave for each press, as far as six octaves below normal

inputs.text: Takes the vMIDI stream whose controller messages become notes; every controller value is converted, despite the manual saying a value below 64 is read as a release

outputs.text: Carries the notes made from the controllers, always on channel 1; nothing else from the input reaches it

notes: the note number is the controller number, plus the CC Base setting, plus twelve times the octave shift; a note landing outside 0 to 127 is not sent at all
only controller messages are converted; notes, clock and everything else arriving at the input are dropped
a controller repeating the value it last sent, within 2 seconds, is ignored, so a control that sends continuously does not flood the output
every message sent is a note on, and a controller value of 0 gives velocity 0, which is how a note is released
the display reads T: and the octave shift, and switches to N: and the last note number for a moment after each note
menu: CC Base: 0, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60, 72, 84, 96, 108, 120 — added to every controller number before it becomes a note, so it sets which note controller 0 produces
